title: Park Guell Tour
text: Park Guell is an unforgetable place that was extremely busy. Having a guide is not necessary but it does enhance the experience. Our guide was knowledgeable and filled us in on a lot of history. There were many tours going through the park at the same time.
author: David_S

title: Good tour
text:
Good tour around the park & interesting information. Guide was thoughtful about finding shade for us to stand & listen to her.
Unfortunately the tour company we were booked with didn't arrive, so I had to telephone the help line & we had been put with another tour company but didn't get that message till we were on our way & I didn't check my phone. So a bit stressed at the meeting point.
author: Ann_L

title: Park Güell.  Incredible
text: Gemma our French-speaking guide was wonderful.  She is very passionate and attentive to others.   We had a very nice visit.
author: Chantal_G

title: Beautiful tour
text:
Everything was very organized,  great experience, my friends and my mom enjoyed the tour a lot. 
Thank you
author: LILIANA_C

title: A must see!
text: This park is a must see. Our tour guide, Isaac, was amazing! He had a great knowledge base and interesting stories.
author: Anders_U

title: Tessa made our experience of Parc Guell exceptional!
text: Our tour guide Maria Teresa or Tessa was wonderful! As a native and university art teacher, she made our tour extra special with her historical knowledge of Parc Guell and the area.  Such a phenomenal story teller, leaving no detail untold!  Parc Guell is just as expansive as it is beautiful with spectacular views!
author: Lisa_A

title: Very steeped in the...
text:
Guide very steeped in Gaudi’s personality and knowledge of his art and good connoisseur of the history of Barcelona’s city planning.
Very exciting and rich visit.
author: Jeanpierre_V

title: Great morning.
text:
It was a great experience start to finish. Finding the location was easy with the directions. Our taxi had no problems. 
Violeta was fabulous. She explained the history, pointed out highlights, and gave insight into the practical uses of the structures. Very enjoyable time. 😁
author: Marian_T

title: Barcelona park tour
text: Very knowledgeable and professional ; would recommend this tour for those who are interested in late 19th to early 20th century design
